condition.question: Do you practice without a joint protocol under the 2026 law?
condition.description: New Jersey's pharmacology hours for APNs practicing without a joint protocol.

agreement.text: APNs prescribe under joint protocols with a collaborating physician, reviewed, updated and signed at least annually. Since March 30, 2026 an APN with more than 5,000 hours in a qualifying population focus who provides primary or behavioral health care may practice without a joint protocol. That exemption does not cover general obstetrics or elective aesthetic or cosmetic services.
